address: Neuer Platz 14, Klagenfurt am Wörthersee, 9020, Austria
bio: Already known for his fine dining restaurant in Maria Wörth, Hubert Wallner has created this terrific spot on the fifth floor of the Sparkasse bank building. The lively, modern bar area includes a wonderful roof terrace. In addition to refined cocktails, they serve a small menu of bar snacks, and a set menu designed for sharing, with delicious dishes such as 'Acquerello truffle risotto', quail breast, watercress or cauliflower, curry, macadamia nut, citrus. On the ground floor, there is also a café-bistro that has a simpler menu of breakfast options, cakes, bowls and pasta dishes....
